body: Heading into 2026, the landscape could continue to reward investors willing to take on a bit of risk. Many of the standout biotech stocks to watch in 2026 have tangible catalysts to drive growth. Helping to motivate investors in the last several quarters has been the completion of the combination of atai Life Sciences and Beckley Psytech, accompanied by a redomiciliation to the United States. Investors may want to watch Atai Beckley for updates on its BPL-003, a nasal spray in development for TRD and alcohol use disorder, which saw positive topline results in a Phase 2b trial last July and other promising data in November. The Phase 3 trial will likely start in the second quarter of 2026. In this way, 2026 may be a make-or-break year for the company. The company’s secret weapon, though, may be REZZAYO, a treatment for candidemia in the midst of a Phase 3 trial, with data expected next quarter.

The **State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF** (XLV +3.06%), which tracks the healthcare sector of the **S&P 500** index, is up 3.3% over the past five trading sessions. That blows away the performance of the broader market -- the S&P 500 is up less than half a percentage point over the past week. And it makes healthcare the top-performing sector in the index for the week. And the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services recently announced it will provide **Eli Lilly's** (LLY +4.28%) GLP-1 drugs, Zepbound and Mounjaro, to Medicare patients for $50 a month beginning in January 2027. In addition, there seems to be sector rotation taking place, with investors rebalancing their portfolios away from pricey tech stocks and into healthcare stocks, which are generally cheaper on a price-to-earnings basis. I like the State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF because it tracks the largest healthcare stocks and is highly diversified.
